baseListing.title: RfScout
baseListing.shortDescription: Receive-only spectrum scanner for the HackRF One.
baseListing.description:
RfScout turns a HackRF One into a wideband spectrum scanner for Windows. It sweeps from 1 MHz to 6 GHz, shows a live spectrum and a scrolling waterfall, finds the signals worth looking at and tracks them, and works out what kind of device is behind each one.

RfScout is receive only: it never transmits, and antenna power and the RF amplifier start off.

Requires a HackRF One (firmware with USB API 1.02 or later) using the WinUSB driver. Install the driver once with the HackRF Windows drivers or Zadig (https://zadig.akeo.ie) before starting RfScout.

Receiving and decoding radio signals is regulated differently from country to country. Make sure your use is legal where you are.

RfScout is free software under the GNU GPL v3 or later. Source code: https://github.com/matsura8/RfScout
features: Wideband sweep from 1 MHz to 6 GHz with band presets
Live spectrum with peak hold and noise floor, plus a colour-mapped waterfall
Automatic peak detection and tracking with SNR, bandwidth and duty cycle
Narrowband analysis with an explainable modulation classifier (AM, FM, OOK, FSK and more)
Identifies ISM sensors (rtl_433), aircraft (ADS-B), FM stations (RDS) and ships (AIS)
Locate mode: large signal-strength meter for hunting a transmitter
